key_features: 【Premium Material】These food clips are made of premium ABS + rubber + plastic, which is thick and strong, odorless, sturdy and suitable for long time use. Each package comes with 6 pcs food clips in 3 different colors (rose red, green, blue), 2 of each color, enough to meet your daily usage needs

【Perfect Design】The cushioned tip of the clip is made of high-quality rubber, with good anti slip effect, comfortable grip, and easy to open. Their surface is smooth, which will not cause damage to your paper or bags. The opening of the clips is larger, so they are easier to open and close than other similar clips

【Tight Sealing】The springs of the bag clips have a strong grip to hold the clips closed. The ribbed tooth design of the clip can firmly clamp the bag, forming an airtight seal to prevent bag air leakage and moisture. These sealing clips are good for keeping food fresh, perfect for home kitchen use and storage

【Wide Application】This plastic bag clip has a range of uses, which is suitable for all kinds of plastic bags and opened food bags, such as bread, chips, cereal, snacks, candies, nuts, cheese, powdered cocoa, and so on. It can also be used in the office as file clamps. These plastic clips are practical gifts for family and friends at festivals
